title: The president who cried tariffs: will the US supreme court challenge Trump’s trade war?
summary: The US high court will hear arguments on whether Trump’s erratic imposition of global tariffs is legally valid Donald Trump thrives on emergencies. He cried havoc on the very first day of his second term, declaring a national emergency caused by an “invasion” of “ illegal aliens ” from Mexico. He has since invoked emergencies more than any president since the passage of the National Emergencies Act in 1976. Next Wednesday, he faces another of his own making, as the US supreme court hears oral arguments on whether his globe-shaking signature economic policy – tariffs – is legally valid. title: Five German climbers die in Italian Alps after being swept away by avalanche
summary: Bodies of missing man and 17-year-old daughter who had fallen 200 metres found on Sunday morning in South Tyrol Five German climbers, including a 17-year-old girl, have died after being swept away by an avalanche in the Italian Alps, rescuers have said. Italian media said three groups of climbers – believed to be travelling independently of one another – were caught in the torrent of snow as it pulsed down a mountain near the Swiss border in the north-eastern region of South Tyrol on Saturday.
